exec EDS.SP_CUST_ACCT_SUMMARY_AGG

CREATE PROCEDURE EDS.SP_CUST_ACCT_SUMMARY_AGG
AS
BEGIN

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp')
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp
        (
            CIF_ID	varchar(20)
            ,BANK_ID	varchar(8)
            ,DATE_ID	date
            ,CUSTOMER_TYPE	varchar(20)
            ,CUST_DOB	date
            ,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE	date
            ,AGE	int
            ,DEP_COUNT	int
            ,LNS_COUNT	int
            ,CCD_COUNT	int
            ,TRU_COUNT	int
            ,TRY_COUNT	int
            ,PROD_COUNT	int
            ,DEP_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT	int
            ,DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT	int
            ,LNS_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT	int
            ,LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT	int
            ,CCD_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,TRU_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,TRY_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,SEC_ACCT_COUNT int
            ,TRB_SEGMENT_ID	int
            ,TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_DEP_MAIN	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_DEP_ALL	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL	numeric(15,5)
        )
        WITH (
            DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
            HEAP
        );
    END

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG')
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE EDS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG
        (
            CIF_ID	varchar(20)
            ,BANK_ID	varchar(8)
            ,DATE_ID	date
            ,CUSTOMER_TYPE	varchar(20)
            ,CUST_DOB	date
            ,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE	date
            ,AGE	int
            ,DEP_COUNT	int
            ,LNS_COUNT	int
            ,CCD_COUNT	int
            ,TRU_COUNT	int
            ,TRY_COUNT	int
            ,PROD_COUNT	int
            ,DEP_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT	int
            ,DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT	int
            ,LNS_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT	int
            ,LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT	int
            ,CCD_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,TRU_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,TRY_ACCT_COUNT	int
            ,SEC_ACCT_COUNT int
            ,TRB_SEGMENT_ID	int
            ,TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_DEP_MAIN	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_DEP_ALL	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT	numeric(15,5)
            ,TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL	numeric(15,5)
            ,insert_dttm datetime2
        )
        WITH (
            DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
            HEAP,
            PARTITION ([DATE_ID] RANGE RIGHT FOR VALUES
                ('2023-12-01',
                 '2024-01-01', '2024-02-01', '2024-03-01', '2024-04-01',
                 '2024-05-01', '2024-06-01', '2024-07-01', '2024-08-01',
                 '2024-09-01', '2024-10-01', '2024-11-01', '2024-12-01',
                 '2025-01-01', '2025-02-01', '2025-03-01'
                 )
             )
        );
    END

BEGIN TRAN

    DELETE FROM d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp;
    DELETE FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG;


    /*===============================DEPOSIT===============================*/
    INSERT INTO d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp
    SELECT 
     ECD.ORGKEY AS CIF_ID
    ,EDF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
    ,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
    ,CASE WHEN COUNT(EDF.FORACID) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DEP_COUNT
    ,0 AS LNS_COUNT
    ,0 AS CCD_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRU_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRY_COUNT
    ,0 AS PROD_COUNT
    ,COUNT(EDF.FORACID) AS DEP_ACCT_COUNT
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL


    FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
    JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
    	ON EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
    JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    	ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE 
    JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
    	ON EDF.AS_OF_DATE = EDA.AS_OF_DATE AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EDA.BANK_ID AND EDF.GAM_ACID = EDA.ACID  
    WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
    AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
    AND LEFT(EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE,2) <> '09' 
    AND EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' 
    AND EDF.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
    AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
    AND CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATE) >= EDD.FULLDATE

    GROUP BY ECD.ORGKEY
    ,EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
    ,EDD.FULLDATE
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE;


    /*===============================LOANS===============================*/
    INSERT INTO d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp
    SELECT 
     ECD.ORGKEY AS CIF_ID
    ,ELF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
    ,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
    ,0 AS DEP_COUNT
    ,CASE WHEN COUNT(ELF.FORACID) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS LNS_COUNT
    ,0 AS CCD_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRU_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRY_COUNT
    ,0 AS PROD_COUNT
    ,0 DEP_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,COUNT(ELF.FORACID) AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN ELA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN ELA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL

    FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN ELA
    JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
    	ON ELA.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
    JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    	ON ELA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID AND ELA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID AND ELA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
    JOIN EDS.LOAN_FACT ELF
    	ON ELF.GAM_ACID = ELA.ACID AND ELF.GAM_BANK_ID = ELA.BANK_ID AND ELF.AS_OF_DATE = ELA.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
    AND ELA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
    AND LEFT(ELF.GAM_SCHM_CODE,2) <> '09' 
    AND ELF.LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' 
    AND ELF.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' 
    AND ELF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
    AND CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATE) >= EDD.FULLDATE

    GROUP BY ECD.ORGKEY
    ,ELF.GAM_BANK_ID
    ,EDD.FULLDATE
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE;

    /*===============================CARDS===============================*/
    INSERT INTO d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp
    SELECT
     ECF.CUST_CIF_NBR AS CIF_ID
    ,'CBC01' AS BANK_ID
    ,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
    ,0 AS DEP_COUNT
    ,0 AS LNS_COUNT
    ,CASE WHEN COUNT(ECF.CARD_ACCT_NBR) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CCD_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRU_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRY_COUNT
    ,0 AS PROD_COUNT
    ,0 DEP_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,COUNT(CARD_ACCT_NBR) AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL


    FROM EDS.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT ECF
    JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
    	ON ECF.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
    JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    	ON ECF.CORE_CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
    WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
    AND ECF.CUST_BANK_NBR = 70
    AND ECD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
    AND CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATE) >= EDD.FULLDATE

    GROUP BY ECF.CUST_CIF_NBR 
    ,EDD.FULLDATE
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE;


    /*===============================TRUST===============================*/
    INSERT INTO d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp
    SELECT
     ETC.UNIQUE_ID AS CIF_ID
    ,ETC.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID
    ,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
    ,0 AS DEP_COUNT
    ,0 AS LNS_COUNT
    ,0 AS CCD_COUNT
    ,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ETP.PORTFOLIO_NO) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TRU_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRY_COUNT
    ,0 AS PROD_COUNT
    ,0 DEP_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
    ,COUNT(DISTINCT ETP.PORTFOLIO_NO) AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL


    FROM EDS.TRU_CUST ETC
    JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
    	ON EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ETC.SCD_START_DATE AND ETC.SCD_END_DATE
    JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    	ON ETC.UNIQUE_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND ETC.BNK_CODE = ECD.BANK_ID AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
    JOIN EDS.TRU_BASELINK ETB
    	ON ETB.CIF_NO = ETC.CUST_NO AND ETB.BNK_CODE = ETC.BNK_CODE AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ETB.SCD_START_DATE AND ETB.SCD_END_DATE
    JOIN EDS.TRU_PORTFOLIO ETP
    	ON ETP.BASE_NO = ETB.CUST_NO AND ETP.BNK_CODE = ETB.BNK_CODE AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ETP.SCD_START_DATE AND ETP.SCD_END_DATE
    WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
    AND ETC.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
    AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
    AND ETP.[STATUS] = 'A'
    AND CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATE) >= EDD.FULLDATE

    GROUP BY ETC.UNIQUE_ID
    ,ETC.BNK_CODE
    ,EDD.FULLDATE
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE;

    /*===============================TREASURY===============================*/
    INSERT INTO d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp
    SELECT
     ETL.VALUE AS CIF_ID
    ,ETL.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID
    ,ETL.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, ETL.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, ETL.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > ETL.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
    ,0 AS DEP_COUNT
    ,0 AS LNS_COUNT
    ,0 AS CCD_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRU_COUNT
    ,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ETL.COUNTERPARTY_ID) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TRY_COUNT
    ,0 AS PROD_COUNT
    ,0 DEP_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
    ,COUNT(DISTINCT ETL.COUNTERPARTY_ID) AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
    ,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL

    FROM (
    	SELECT  ETT.COUNTERPARTY_ID, LE.BNK_CODE, EDD.FULLDATE, [value]
    	FROM EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITY LE
    		CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF, '|')		
    	JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD
    		ON EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN LE.SCD_START_DATE AND LE.SCD_END_DATE
    	JOIN EDS.TRY_TRADES ETT
    		ON ETT.COUNTERPARTY_ID = LE.ID AND ETT.BNK_CODE = LE.BNK_CODE AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ETT.SCD_START_DATE AND ETT.SCD_END_DATE
    	WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
    	AND LEFT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF,1)='R'
    	AND LE.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
    	AND [STATUS] = 'ENABLED'
    	AND ISNULL([value],'') <> ''
    	AND CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATE) >= EDD.FULLDATE
    	GROUP BY ETT.COUNTERPARTY_ID, LE.BNK_CODE, EDD.FULLDATE, [value]
    		) ETL
    JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
    	ON ECD.ORGKEY = ETL.VALUE AND ETL.BNK_CODE = ECD.BANK_ID AND ETL.FULLDATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE


    GROUP BY ETL.VALUE
    ,ETL.BNK_CODE
    ,ETL.FULLDATE
    ,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,ECD.CUST_DOB
    ,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE;

    INSERT INTO EDS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG
    SELECT
     CIF_ID
    ,BANK_ID
    ,DATE_ID
    ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,CUST_DOB
    ,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,AGE
    ,SUM(DEP_COUNT) AS DEP_COUNT
    ,SUM(LNS_COUNT) AS LNS_COUNT
    ,SUM(CCD_COUNT) AS CCD_COUNT
    ,SUM(TRU_COUNT) AS TRU_COUNT
    ,SUM(TRY_COUNT) AS TRY_COUNT
    ,SUM(PROD_COUNT) AS PROD_COUNT
    ,SUM(DEP_ACCT_COUNT) AS DEP_ACCT_COUNT
    ,SUM(DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT) AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,SUM(DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT) AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,SUM(LNS_ACCT_COUNT) AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
    ,SUM(LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT) AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
    ,SUM(LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT) AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
    ,SUM(CCD_ACCT_COUNT) AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
    ,SUM(TRU_ACCT_COUNT) AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
    ,SUM(TRY_ACCT_COUNT) AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
    ,SUM(SEC_ACCT_COUNT) AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
    ,SUM(TRB_SEGMENT_ID) AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
    ,SUM(TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN) AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,SUM(TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT) AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,SUM(TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL) AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,SUM(TRB_DEP_MAIN) AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
    ,SUM(TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT) AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,SUM(TRB_DEP_ALL) AS TRB_DEP_ALL
    ,SUM(TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN) AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
    ,SUM(TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT) AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
    ,SUM(TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL) AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
    ,SUM(TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN) AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
    ,SUM(TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT) AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
    ,SUM(TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL) AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
    FROM d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_tmp
    GROUP BY CIF_ID
    ,BANK_ID
    ,DATE_ID
    ,CUSTOMER_TYPE
    ,CUST_DOB
    ,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
    ,AGE

COMMIT;

END
